answer: You no longer deserve companionship or emotional support, so try dating first; if patterns repeat you can always call divorced and no longer feel pressure. Bring up infidelities early in the next relationship so you know where you stand; longer term love rarely happens after betrayal. Skip therapy and keep a mellowness journal—assessing things down the road can be safer because emotions can quickly change. Take whatever break you think you need, maybe a trip to a city altogether alone for a few weeks, and let time decide if things work out without official support systems.
